features.name: Scaffold Vite + React app
features.description: Run npm create vite@latest with the react template in this directory; confirm npm run dev serves the default page

features.name: Initialize git repository
features.description: git init on main, create .gitignore (node_modules, dist, test artifacts, playwright-report), initial commit

features.name: Install dependencies
features.description: npm install; add devDependencies: vitest, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, jsdom, @playwright/test, prettier, eslint, eslint-config-prettier; add eslint.config.js (flat config, prettier-compatible); add scripts: lint (eslint .), test (vitest run), test:e2e (playwright test), format (prettier --write); run npx playwright install chromium; engines >=20

features.name: Create tokens.css
features.description: src/styles/tokens.css with every token from docs/design-system.md (colors, fonts, sizes, radii, spacing, motion), exported as CSS custom properties under :root

features.name: Load Space Grotesk font
features.description: Add Space Grotesk (400/500/700) via Google Fonts in index.html; font stacks reference tokens

features.name: Base styles
features.description: Body background/text tokens, h1-h3 type scale per design system, base link styles, selection color

features.name: Focus rings and reduced motion
features.description: Global 2px accent focus ring on all interactive elements; prefers-reduced-motion disables transitions

features.name: Navbar with anchor links
features.description: Fixed top navbar: logo 'andresbetov', links About/Skills/Projects/Contact (#about #skills #projects #contact), accent hover

features.name: Hero section
features.description: H1 'Andres Bermudez', tagline mentioning software engineer + space exploration, primary CTA 'View Projects' (#projects) and secondary 'Contact' (#contact)

features.name: Section shells and footer
features.description: Section components with 96px (64px mobile) padding and H2 headings; footer with social links (GitHub, LinkedIn, X, Instagram) with correct hrefs

features.name: About section
features.description: Bio: systems engineering student + fullstack developer from Colombia, space-exploration interest, brief professional summary

features.name: Skills section
features.description: Card grid: Backend (Java, Spring Boot, microservices), Frontend (React, JavaScript), Data/Quant (Python, portfolio analytics); cards per component spec

features.name: Projects section
features.description: 3 hardcoded cards with titles, one-line descriptions, and GitHub links: Elara App, hierarchical-clustering-portfolio-selector, xai-financial-predictor-engine

features.name: Contact section
features.description: Contact heading, short message, email or social CTA; linked from nav

features.name: Responsive layout
features.description: Breakpoints 768/1024px per design system: card grids collapse to one column on mobile, navbar links readable without wrapping

features.name: Hover and motion states
features.description: Hover states per design system (buttons, cards, links) with 150-200ms ease transitions; no motion when prefers-reduced-motion

features.name: Fix 320px overflow
features.description: Verify no horizontal overflow at 320px (long words, fixed widths, padding); make grids fluid with minmax/auto-fit

features.name: Vitest smoke tests green
features.description: src/__tests__/App.test.jsx passes: hero, 4 nav anchors, 3 project links, social hrefs, no overflow at 320px

features.name: Playwright specs green
features.description: e2e/portfolio.spec.js passes at 1440/768/390/320: no console errors, no overflow, anchors scroll, hover state, screenshots captured

features.name: Meta tags and favicon
features.description: Title, description, Open Graph tags, theme-color, and a simple favicon (SVG 'AB' mark in accent green)

features.name: README and final audit
features.description: Minimal README (project, stack, commands, links); run ui-designer audit and qa-visual-tester, fix any P0/P1 findings

features.name: CI e2e job
features.description: Add Playwright e2e job to .github/workflows/ci.yml: install chromium, run npm run test:e2e, upload screenshots (portfolio-desktop/mobile.png) and playwright-report as artifacts

features.name: GitHub Pages deploy
features.description: Add Pages workflow to .github/workflows/ci.yml: build on main push and deploy dist to GitHub Pages
